dimensions.evidenceA: Both robbers are included in the plural.
dimensions.label: Insulting speakers

dimensions.evidenceB: He rebukes the first and speaks to Jesus.
dimensions.label: Second criminal

evidence.observation: The robbers crucified with Jesus cast the same reproach on him.
One criminal insults Jesus; the other rebukes him and addresses Jesus with hope.

record.tension: The witnesses assign the criminals’ responses differently.
record.title: Do both criminals reproach Jesus?
